title: Waive a late / overdraft fee
summary: Ask for a one-time courtesy waiver as a customer in good standing; set up a safeguard so it won't recur.
goal_default: I'd like to request a one-time courtesy waiver of this fee.

rights.claim: First-time or rare fees are frequently waived as a one-time courtesy for customers in good standing.
rights.basis: Standard goodwill-adjustment practice at banks and providers.

rights.claim: Setting up alerts or autopay while you ask shows good faith and prevents a repeat.
rights.basis: Practical safeguard that strengthens the request.

ladder: Mention switching if you are a long-time customer
disclaimer: This is information to help you prepare your own request. It is not legal advice and guarantees no outcome.
